text:
MPC inched up 0.31% today to close at $388.90, extending a strong two-week rally of nearly 8%. The modest daily gain reflects a refining sector benefiting from elevated oil and fuel prices: crude oil hit six-week highs after Iran-U.S. military escalation, gasoline prices topped $4 per gallon for Labor Day—a record—and U.S. refineries are running at 98% capacity. For a major refiner like this, higher crude prices and near-maximum utilization create favorable conditions for profit margins, even if the stock's momentum appears to have temporarily paused.

The broader backdrop remains supportive for oil-linked equities. Geopolitical risk in the Middle East continues to tighten crude supply, and with gasoline inventories relatively lean at 205.7 million barrels, the refining industry faces persistent strong demand heading into the fall.
